indicators.name: Customer Inflation (CPI)
indicators.impact: CPI shows what consumers are already absorbing, which helps owners judge customer purchasing pressure.

indicators.name: Producer Cost Pressure (PPI)
indicators.impact: PPI tracks upstream supplier pressure and often matters to owners before CPI does.

indicators.name: Energy / Fuel Pressure
indicators.impact: Oil and fuel prices move quickly into delivery, freight, commuting, field service, and supplier surcharges.

indicators.name: Interest Rate Pressure
indicators.impact: Rates affect credit lines, equipment financing, inventory financing, and expansion decisions.

indicators.name: Labor Cost Pressure
indicators.impact: Labor is one of the biggest recurring expenses for many small and medium-sized businesses, so wage pressure deserves its own card.

indicators.name: Monetary Backdrop (M2)
indicators.impact: M2 stays on the page as a separate macro backdrop for longer-range purchasing-power pressure.
